headline: Senior Data Analyst | Business Intelligence Specialist
summary: Analytically-minded Data Professional with over 7 years of experience in the Nepalese banking and technology sectors. Expertise in transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable business strategies through advanced SQL, Python scripting, and interactive BI dashboards. Proven track record of improving operational efficiency and risk assessment models.

experiences.title: Senior Data Analyst
description: Lead the data analytics team in identifying transaction trends to support the fraud detection unit, reducing unauthorized transactions by 15%.
Develop and maintain automated financial reporting dashboards using Power BI and DAX for the executive management committee.
Collaborate with the Risk Management department to refine credit scoring models using historical loan performance data.
Optimize complex SQL queries across large-scale Oracle databases, improving report generation speed by 40%.

experiences.title: Data Analyst
description: Performed deep-dive exploratory data analysis (EDA) for international healthcare clients to identify key performance drivers.
Built and deployed data pipelines using Python (Pandas, NumPy) to clean and transform raw unstructured data into structured formats.
Utilized Tableau to create interactive visualizations for project stakeholders, facilitating data-driven decision-making.
Conducted A/B testing on product features to measure user engagement and retention metrics.

experiences.title: Junior Data Analyst
description: Monitored and reported on data quality metrics for large-scale data labeling projects.
Automated weekly productivity reports using Advanced Excel and VBA, saving 10 hours of manual work per week.
Assisted in the extraction of data from various internal sources using SQL for ad-hoc analysis requests.
Liaised with project managers to identify bottlenecks in the data processing lifecycle.
